title: UPSC CAPF AC 2026 Result and Name Wise List
postName: Combined Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination 2026
qualification: Bachelor Degree in any stream from a recognized university in India
ageLimit: 20 to 25 years as on 01/08/2026; age relaxation as per UPSC CAPF rules
applicationFee: General / OBC: Rs. 200; SC / ST and all category female candidates: exempted
selectionProcess: Written Examination -> Physical Standards / Physical Efficiency Tests -> Medical Standards Tests -> Interview / Personality Test -> Final Merit
documentsRequired: Roll number, name-wise result details, application credentials and valid photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://upsc.gov.in
2. Open the CAPF (AC) Examination 2026 result notice
3. Download the roll-wise or name-wise result PDF
4. Search your roll number or name in the appropriate list
5. Follow UPSC instructions for the next selection stage
shortDescription: UPSC CAPF AC 2026 Result released with roll-wise and name-wise lists for 349 Assistant Commandant posts. Download result, answer key and official notices.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Combined Central Armed Police Forces (Assistant Commandants) Examination 2026 Result.

Candidates can download the roll-wise result and name-wise list for the 349-post CAPF AC recruitment. The result covers BSF, CRPF, CISF, ITBP and SSB vacancies.

Important updates

  • Written examination: 19 July 2026
  • Answer key: 22 July 2026
  • Result available: 25 August 2026
  • Name-wise list updated: 08 September 2026

Download the official PDF from UPSC and search your roll number or name carefully. Candidates should follow the official notice for physical tests, medical standards and further selection instructions.
